evals.prompt: Coordinate a backend fix and independent browser audit with two worker chats; a successor coordinator is needed while both slots are busy.
evals.expected_output: Queue succession until a slot is free, keep one coordinator, assign separate executor and inspector, and transfer the ledger.
expectations: At most three visible chats run at once
Exactly one coordinator owns the user-facing role
Executor and inspector are different
Successor receives a handoff

evals.prompt: A worker repeats the same investigation twice, says it is 10% done, and wants to start another container.
evals.expected_output: Request concrete evidence, replan a bounded task, and retain shared-resource controls.
expectations: Two repeated unsuccessful attempts trigger replanning
The worker reports concrete state and remaining work
A new container is not started without the applicable authorization

evals.prompt: A worker requests a narrow sub-agent to examine a log while the two shared heavy-worker slots are occupied.
evals.expected_output: Route the request through the coordinator and queue it until capacity and authorization exist.
expectations: Coordinator controls sub-agent dispatch
The shared two-heavy-worker limit applies to sub-agents

evals.prompt: Allocate the initial coordinator, its successor, one inspector and one executor. An inspector requests a child while both worker slots are occupied.
evals.expected_output: Use 0000, 0001, 1000 and 2000; queue the child until the coordinator approves and capacity exists.
expectations: The initial coordinator is 0000 and the successor is 0001
The inspector is 1000 and the executor is 2000
The child is queued until approved capacity exists

evals.prompt: There are 11 retained children across both worker roles, of which three are completed and eligible for deletion. The deletion tool confirms deletion for two and fails for one.
evals.expected_output: Count both roles, delete only eligible children, release only the two confirmed IDs, and retain the unconfirmed ID.
expectations: The shared bucket counts both roles
No active child is deleted
Only confirmed deletions release IDs
No more than seven children are selected

evals.prompt: A completed child 1003 has no supported deletion capability. Another inspector requests its ID.
evals.expected_output: Retain 1003 as reserved and allocate another available inspector ID; report deletion is unavailable.
expectations: 1003 remains reserved
The new inspector does not reuse 1003
The deletion limitation is reported

evals.prompt: Coordinator 0009 has finished its assigned work; predecessors 0000 through 0008 were confirmed deleted and one chat slot is available. Describe the rollover.
evals.expected_output: Create successor 0000, hand off deletion of 0009, transfer the sole coordinator role, stop 0009, and confirm deletion.
expectations: The old 0000 is confirmed deleted before reuse
New 0000 is instructed to delete 0009
0009 stops before deletion
The registry records a new cycle

evals.prompt: Coordinator 0009 needs rollover but the platform cannot delete the old 0000.
evals.expected_output: Keep 0000 reserved, report the blocker, and do not create another task with 0000.
expectations: The old 0000 remains reserved
No duplicate 0000 is created
The limitation is reported

evals.prompt: An inspector has completed its assigned review while its parent coordinator is waiting. What must the inspector do?
evals.expected_output: Send the parent a completion message with the result and evidence without waiting for the user to read the chat.
expectations: The inspector sends a completion message to its parent
The message includes the result and evidence
The worker does not wait for user pickup

evals.prompt: A nested child needs credentials to proceed. Its parent cannot resolve the issue. Describe the reporting chain.
evals.expected_output: The child notifies its parent without sending a secret; the parent promptly escalates to the coordinator, who requests user action securely.
expectations: The child notifies its parent of the blocker
The parent escalates the unresolved issue to the coordinator
Only the coordinator requests action from the user
No secret is sent in the message

evals.prompt: You are a coordinator using a powerful model. A routine screenshot inspection can be performed by an available Luna worker, and the spawn tool permits selecting its model. What do you select?
evals.expected_output: Explicitly select Luna for the bounded inspection rather than inheriting the coordinator model.
expectations: The child is assigned Luna explicitly
The coordinator does not rely on inherited model selection

evals.prompt: A child must use a browser tool unavailable to the lighter model, and a stronger available model supports it. Choose a model and explain the exception.
evals.expected_output: Select the capable stronger model and record the missing browser capability as the reason.
expectations: The selected model supports the required browser tool
The stronger-model exception is documented

evals.prompt: A child-creation tool does not permit model selection. How should the coordinator proceed?
evals.expected_output: Record the limitation and use an authorized available model without claiming a lighter model was selected.
expectations: The unavailable model selection is recorded
No model override is claimed
